files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/documents/work/meetings/', entry_type='files', recursive=True)
base_dir = '/home/catherine/documents/work/meetings/'

for file_path in files:
    filename = os.path.basename(file_path)
    parts = filename.split('__')
    if len(parts) == 2:
        date_part = parts[0]
        name_ext = parts[1]
        name, ext = os.path.splitext(name_ext)
        new_dir = os.path.join(base_dir, name)
        new_path = os.path.join(new_dir, date_part + ext)

        print('Moving', file_path, '->', new_path)
        print(apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=access_token, source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=new_path))
